title: crop
intro:
The ’crop’ component simulates a specific crop on the field, typically averaged over
one square meter, not individual plants. Of particular interest is water and nitrogen
uptake at different depths, and the vertical leaf area distribution, which are used
for competition with other crops.

attrs.name: water stress effect
attrs.doc:
Effect of water stress on production. By default, this will be ’none’ iff the
        selected photosynthesis model does handle water stress implicitly, and ’full’
        otherwise.

attrs.name: enable N stress
attrs.doc:
Set this true to let nitrogen stress limit production. By default, it will be true
     iff the selected photosynthesis model does handle nitrogen stress implicitly.

attrs.name: min light fraction
attrs.doc:
When multiple crops are competing for light, this parameter specifies a minu-
     mum amount of the light this crop will receive. The idea is that the field has
     patches where one crop is dominating, as specified by this parameter, and in
     these patches the crop will not have to compete for light. The crop still needs
     LAI in order to catch the light though. Competition for water and nutrients
     are unaffected.

attrs.name: sunlit

Leaf photosynthesis for sunlit leaves. This will be zero if the selected radiation
     distribution model does not distinguish between sunlit and shadow leafs.

attrs.name: reserved
attrs.doc:
Leaf photosynthesis for reserved leaves. This is used for simulating ”patches”
     in multi-crop systems, such as a clover-grass mixture. This is controled by
     the ’min light fraction’ parameter.

sections.text:
Standard Daisy crop model. Hansen, 1999.
  < default (CrpN CrpN )                                             ; Has partial value.
               (Harvest Harvest )                                    ; Has default value.
               (Seed Seed )                                          ; Default LAI value.
               (Root Root )                                          ; Default classic value.
               (Canopy Canopy )                                      ; Has partial value.
               (Prod Prod )                                          ; Has partial value.
               (last time last time )
               (sow time sow time )
               (emerge time emerge time )
               (flowering time flowering time )
               (ripe time ripe time )
               (Devel Devel )
               (CStage CStage )                                      ; Default Daisy value.
               (Partit Partit )                                      ; Has partial value.
               (Vernal Vernal )                                      ; Default none value.
               (LeafPhot LeafPhot )                                  ; Default GL value.
               (water stress effect water stress effect )
               (enable N stress enable N stress )
               (min light fraction 0 [<fraction>])
               (RubiscoN RubiscoN )                                  ; Default default value. >
    CrpN : CrpN fixed component (see section 107.6)
     Submodel (has partially specified default value)
     Nitrogen parameters.
    Harvest: Harvesting fixed component (see section 107.7)
     Submodel (has fully specified default value)
     Harvest parameters.
    Seed : seed component (see chapter 79)
     Component (default ‘LAI’)
     Initial crop growth.

       Root: root component (see chapter 72)
        Component (default ‘classic’)
        Root system.

       Canopy: CanopyStandard fixed component (see section 107.5)
        Submodel (has partially specified default value)
        Canopy.

       Prod : Production fixed component (see section 107.9)
        Submodel (has partially specified default value)
        Production.

       last time: Time fixed component (see section 107.27)
        Optional submodel
        The time of the previous timestep. Don’t set, calculated by Daisy.

       sow time: Time fixed component (see section 107.27)
        Optional submodel
        The time the crop was sown. Don’t set, calculated by Daisy.

       emerge time: Time fixed component (see section 107.27)
        Optional submodel
        The time the crop emerged. Don’t set, calculated by Daisy.

       flowering time: Time fixed component (see section 107.27)
        Optional submodel
        The time the crop flowered. Don’t set, calculated by Daisy.

       ripe time: Time fixed component (see section 107.27)
        Optional submodel
        The time the crop became ripe. Don’t set, calculated by Daisy.

       Devel : phenology component (see chapter 63)
        Development and phenology.

       CStage: cstage component (see chapter 30)
        Component (default ‘Daisy’)
        Phenological messages.

       Partit: Partition fixed component (see section 107.8)
        Submodel (has partially specified default value)
        Assimilate partitioning.

       Vernal : vernalization component (see chapter 101)
        Component (default ‘none’)
        Vernalization.

       LeafPhot: photosynthesis component (see chapter 64)
        Component (default ‘GL’)
        Leaf photosynthesis. Note that if the selected radiation distribution model
        distinguishes between sunlit and shadow leaves, only the shadow leaves will
        be

       water stress effect: wse component (see chapter 104)
        Optional component
        Effect of water stress on production. By default, this will be ’none’ iff the
        selected photosynthesis model does handle water stress implicitly, and ’full’
        otherwise.

    enable N stress: boolean (see section 4.1.2)
     Optional parameter
     Set this true to let nitrogen stress limit production. By default, it will be true
     iff the selected photosynthesis model does handle nitrogen stress implicitly.
    min light fraction: number [<fraction>]
     Parameter (default 0)

     When multiple crops are competing for light, this parameter specifies a minu-
     mum amount of the light this crop will receive. The idea is that the field has
     patches where one crop is dominating, as specified by this parameter, and in
     these patches the crop will not have to compete for light. The crop still needs
     LAI in order to catch the light though. Competition for water and nutrients
     are unaffected.
    RubiscoN : rubiscoN component (see chapter 74)
     Component (default ‘default’)
     Fraction of N in leaves that is photosynthetically active.

Log Variables
    sunlit: photosynthesis component (see chapter 64)
     Leaf photosynthesis for sunlit leaves. This will be zero if the selected radiation
     distribution model does not distinguish between sunlit and shadow leafs.
    reserved : photosynthesis component (see chapter 64)
     Leaf photosynthesis for reserved leaves. This is used for simulating ”patches”
     in multi-crop systems, such as a clover-grass mixture. This is controled by
     the ’min light fraction’ parameter.

sections.desc:
A ‘Potato; SCRI’ model (see 29.21, page 175) defined in ‘potato.dai’.
   These parameters represent common traits from various site specific calibrations
performed as part of the FertOrgaNic project from 2003-2005. It is not recom-
mended for direct use, but as a base for a veriety specific calibration.
   The calibration was perfomed by Charlotte Tofteng <cto@kvl.dk> in 2006.

Forced growth crop model.
  < simple (Root Root )                                     ; Default classic value.
              (Canopy Canopy )                              ; Has default value.
              (LAIvsTS LAIvsTS )
              (LAIvsDay LAIvsDay )
              (forced LAI 0 [m2 /m2 ])
              (height max 80 [cm])
              (T sum 0 [dg C d])
              (day 0 [d])
              (spring spring ...)                           ; Has default value.
              (spring LAI 0.1 [m2 /m2 ])
              (root DM 2 [Mg DM/ha])
              (root N 20 [kg N/ha])
              (root am root am ...)                         ; Has default value.
              (potential N potential N )
              (N actual 0 [g N/m2 ])
              (N b 10 [kg N/ha])
              (N flowering 0.9 [<fraction>]) >

       Root: root component (see chapter 72)
        Component (default ‘classic’)
        Root system.

       Canopy: CanopySimple fixed component (see section 107.4)
        Submodel (has fully specified default value)
        Canopy.

       LAIvsTS : plf [dg C d → m2 /m2 ]
        Optional parameter
        LAI as a function of T sum

       LAIvsDay: plf [d → m2 /m2 ]
        Optional parameter
        LAI as a function of number of days since sowing.

       forced LAI : number [m2 /m2 ]
        State variable (default 0)
        Minimum LAI, automatically cleared when exceeded by ’LAIvsTS’.

       height max : number [cm]
        Parameter (default 80)
        Maximum height of plant, reached when flowering.

       T sum: number [dg C d]
        State variable (default 0)
        Temperature sum since sowing (or spring).

       day: number [d]
        State variable (default 0)
        Number of days since sowing (or spring).

       spring: integer array of length 2
        Parameter (has default value with length 2)

        (spring 3 1)

    Parameter description:
    Zero ’T sum’ at this month and day.
   spring LAI : number [m2 /m2 ]
    Parameter (default 0.1)
    Set ’forced LAI’ to this after spring clearence of ’T sum’.
   root DM : number [Mg DM/ha]
    Parameter (default 2)
    Fully developed root drymatter.

   root N : number [kg N/ha]
